latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Health Manager, a comprehensive health data management system.

- Track and record blood pressure, heart rate, exercise, and medication via CLI.
- Analyze health trends: blood pressure, heart rate, and exercise statistics.
- Manage medication and health reminders.
- Generate daily, weekly, and handbook-style health reports in Markdown.
- Import/export data in CSV/JSON formats; backup and restore capabilities.
- Customize user and reminder configuration.
